entries.summary: K8 room-seat: projection values gain the optional triggerMessageId (#1449). Only a seat that a room_call opened has it: the message the seat answers, which is the caller's post (its seat id) or, when the caller passed, the message the caller answered (its own triggerMessageId, else the root). A mentioned seat never has it, so a Host tells the two apart by this field and does not derive it from the seat id. A Host that validates the value with a closed schema allows the field before it upgrades; a Host that vendored K8 copies src/rules/rooms.ts. Seats opened before the upgrade are not backfilled.
